test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Children and adolescents with __a morbid compulsion to steal__ experience a growing sense of tension just before stealing, followed by pleasure, relief or gratification during or just after stealing.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Kleptomania".**​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **kleptomania **is a mental disorder characterized by an** irresistible urge to steal items that are not needed or have little value**. A person with kleptomania may feel** a sense of tension before committing theft and relief of gratification afterward, even though they may not use or sell the stolen items**.(चोरी करने की बीमारी से पीड़ित)
 
• *Example: Lakhan outright suffers from Kleptomania, often stealing things in arm's reach just because he feels the impulse to*.​
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"Kleptomania"**.

Therefore the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The rest of the options are incorrect because;
 
• **Pyromania:** An obsessive desire to set fire to things.(चीजों को आग लगाने की जुनूनी इच्छा)
 
• **Dipsomania**: A strong need to drink alcohol. (शराब की लत)
 
• **Megalomania**: A mental disorder or condition in which a person has an exaggerated belief in their own power or importance (महान या भव्य प्रदर्शन का उन्माद)
